tools.name: charge_hotel_deposit
tools.description: Charges the traveler's saved card for a hotel reservation deposit, calculated as a percentage of the nightly rate times the number of nights. Returns the payment ID and the amount charged.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the traveler.

params.name: nightly_rate
params.description: Nightly room rate in major currency units.

params.name: deposit_pct
params.description: Deposit percentage between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20.

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Defaults to usd.

tools.name: refund_flight_and_notify
tools.description: Refunds all or part of a flight booking payment to the traveler's original card, then emails the traveler a refund confirmation with the amount and refund ID.

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent ID of the original flight purchase.

params.name: traveler_email
params.description: Email address to send the refund confirmation to.

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Amount to refund in cents; omit for a full refund.

params.name: reason
params.description: Refund reason: requested_by_customer, duplicate, or fraudulent.

tools.name: purchase_travel_insurance
tools.description: Charges the traveler's saved card for the given travel insurance premium on a trip. Returns the payment ID and its status.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the traveler.

params.name: trip_id
params.description: Trip identifier the coverage applies to.

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("travel-insurance")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_travel_insurance(customer_id: str, payment_method_id: str, trip_id: str, premium_cents: int) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=premium_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Travel insurance for trip {trip_id}",
        metadata={"trip_id": trip_id, "product": "travel_insurance"},
    )
    return {"payment_intent_id": intent.id, "status": intent.status, "amount_cents": intent.amount}

tools.name: archive_cancelled_itinerary
tools.description: For a cancelled trip, permanently deletes the traveler's boarding pass files and moves the itinerary folder into the cancelled-trips archive.
tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

TRIPS_ROOT = Path("/srv/travel/itineraries/active")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/travel/itineraries/cancelled")


def archive_cancelled_itinerary(trip_id: str) -> dict:
    src = TRIPS_ROOT / trip_id
    passes = list(src.glob("boarding_pass_*.pdf"))
    for p in passes:
        p.unlink()
    ARCHIVE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = ARCHIVE_ROOT / trip_id
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    return {"trip_id": trip_id, "boarding_passes_deleted": len(passes), "archived_to": str(dest)}
